package recording_test

import (
	bitwire "github.com/Bitspark/bitwire/wire/go"
	"context"
	binding "example.test/generated/api/go/handles-binding"
	client "example.test/generated/api/go/handles-client"
	protocol "example.test/generated/api/go/handles-protocol"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/duplex/go"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/live/go"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/runtime/go"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type handleDestination struct{ values chan protocol.Callback }

func (d handleDestination) Handle(_ context.Context, value protocol.Callback) error {
	d.values <- value
	return nil
}
func localScope(t *testing.T) *live.Scope {
	t.Helper()
	left, right := duplex.Pipe(1 << 20)
	var scope *live.Scope
	a, err := runtime.NewPeer(context.Background(), left, runtime.ClientRole, runtime.Options{Prepare: func(p *runtime.Peer) (err error) { scope, err = live.Over(p, live.Options{}); return }})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	b, err := runtime.NewPeer(context.Background(), right, runtime.ServerRole, runtime.Options{Prepare: func(p *runtime.Peer) error { _, err := live.Over(p, live.Options{}); return err }})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { a.Close(); b.Close() })
	return scope
}
func handleTarget(t *testing.T, scope *live.Scope) (bitwire.Endpoint, chan protocol.Callback) {
	t.Helper()
	values := make(chan protocol.Callback, 4)
	wire, err := client.ToWire(func(protocol.Server) (protocol.Client, error) {
		return protocol.Client{Events: handleDestination{values}}, nil
	}, runtime.AdapterContext{ValueEnvironment: live.ValueEnvironment(scope)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { wire.Close(1000, "done") })
	return wire, values
}
func handleNext(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, values <-chan protocol.Callback) protocol.Callback {
	t.Helper()
	select {
	case value := <-values:
		return value
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
		return nil
	}
}
func TestLiveHistoryPreservesScopeAndOwner(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	scope := localScope(t)
	owner := scope.Owner().Child()
	wire, values := handleTarget(t, scope)
	store := duplex.NewMemoryWireLog()
	recorded, err := binding.Record(ctx, wire, store, duplex.RecordOptions{}, runtime.AdapterContext{ValueEnvironment: live.ValueEnvironment(scope)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer recorded.Close(1000, "done")
	var effects atomic.Int64
	callback := func(_ context.Context, value int64) (int64, error) { effects.Add(1); return value + 1, nil }
	if err := recorded.Append(live.WithOwner(ctx, owner), binding.RecordedHandle{Data: callback}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	original := handleNext(t, ctx, values)
	if value, err := original(ctx, 3); err != nil || value != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("original %d %v", value, err)
	}
	second, replayed := handleTarget(t, scope)
	follower, err := recorded.Follow(ctx, 0, second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer follower.Close()
	same := handleNext(t, ctx, replayed)
	if value, err := same(ctx, 4); err != nil || value != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("same scope %d %v", value, err)
	}
	if owner.Counts().Exports != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("replay duplicated export: %+v", owner.Counts())
	}
	another := localScope(t)
	otherWire, foreign := handleTarget(t, another)
	foreignFollower, err := recorded.Follow(ctx, 0, otherWire)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer foreignFollower.Close()
	foreignCall := handleNext(t, ctx, foreign)
	if _, err := foreignCall(ctx, 5); !isCode(err, "reference_unknown") {
		t.Fatalf("cross scope invocation: %v", err)
	}
	if effects.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatal("foreign replay reached original callable")
	}
	if err := owner.Release(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if owner.Counts().Exports != 0 {
		t.Fatal("recording retained released owner")
	}
	if _, err := same(ctx, 6); !isCode(err, "reference_released") {
		t.Fatalf("released replay alias: %v", err)
	}
	entry, err := store.Read(ctx, 1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := protocol.ImportCallback(scope.Owner(), entry.Message.Frame.Data); !isCode(err, "reference_released") {
		t.Fatalf("released history import: %v", err)
	}
	if effects.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatal("release was bypassed")
	}
}
